sentence: The manager can choose the opening hours of the shop.
synonym: decide the opening times of the shop
synonymNote: 两者都表示确定商店的营业时间，意思相同。

distractors.word: change the opening hours of the shop
distractors.note: change强调改变，不是选择决定营业时间。

distractors.word: check the opening hours of the shop
distractors.note: check是查看核实，不是做出选择决定。

distractors.word: close the opening hours of the shop
distractors.note: close表示关闭，与选择营业时间意思相反。
